name: Carousel
purpose: A slide container that shows one item of a set at a time (or a peeking neighbour, in the peek/snap variant), navigated by dot buttons, prev/next arrows, or keyboard — with aria-roledescription="carousel" semantics per the APG carousel pattern. PROPOSED at #210 wave-4 lane C; not registered, not ruled.

props.name: variant
props.$note: standard = one slide fills the viewport, transform/hidden-driven, JS owns every position change. peek = native CSS scroll-snap-type:x mandatory, neighbour slides visible at both edges; JS only mirrors dot state via IntersectionObserver so direct swipe/scroll and the buttons never disagree.

props.name: slideCount
props.$note: Drives the dot row and the aria-label "N of M" on each slide; authoring-time, not user-facing.

props.name: autoplay
props.$note: PROPOSED DEFAULT OFF, not built as an option in this snippet. Dave's — see the receipt's $decisionsForDave: does an opt-in autoplay variant belong in the library at all, given WCAG 2.2.2 timing-adjustable and the mixed UX record of autoplaying carousels.

variants.name: standard
variants.use: One slide fills the viewport; prev/next arrows swap the visible slide, dots show position.

variants.name: peek/snap
variants.use: Native scroll-snap with neighbour slides peeking at both edges — signals 'there is more' without a caption saying so.

tokens.arrow: tertiary/background/default surface, icon/default glyph, tertiary/background/hover on hover, tertiary/background/pressed + text/reverse on press — same button-chrome discipline as Segmented-control's non-fill buttons
tokens.dot: border/subtle (off) / text/default (on) — one pair reused for both prev/next iconography and dot state, no invented indicator token
tokens.$contrast: focus/ring on every interactive control (arrows + dots); dot hit target is an invisible >=44px ::before, additive-only, mirrors Segmented-control's hit-area idiom

motion.slideTransition: 220ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) for the standard variant's transform; scroll-behavior:smooth for peek's native scroll.
motion.reducedMotion: Both removed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — instant cut, no smooth scroll, matching Tabs' indicator and Skeleton-loader's shimmer precedent.

responsive.rule: Width is the container's (s210-D3 discipline applied): --demo-width is demo chrome only, no fixed max-width baked into .carousel itself. Peek variant's slide width is a calc() against 100% of the viewport, not a fixed px.

mustNotNeighbour: A second autoplaying region on the same page (competing motion, WCAG 2.2.2)
triggeredBy: a set of 2+ equally-weighted items with no natural list reading order

accessibility.role: The region carries aria-roledescription="carousel"; each slide carries aria-roledescription="slide" + aria-label="N of M" (APG naming pattern — first use in this repo, probe run at build: 0 pre-existing hits). Slide changes are NOT modelled as role=tab/tabpanel — a carousel slide is not an independent view the way a tab panel is (APG 2024 guidance).
accessibility.name: aria-label on the carousel region names the set ("Featured offers"); each dot button carries its own "Go to slide N of M" label.
accessibility.keyboard: Left/Right/Home/End on the dot group move the active slide (roving tabindex, same idiom as Tabs); the arrow BUTTONS are separate real tab stops that also advance/retreat one slide.
accessibility.focus: focus-visible outline on arrows and dots; the peek variant's native scroll never traps focus because scrolling is not itself a focus event.
accessibility.nonText: Placeholder SVGs carry role="img" + a descriptive aria-label — never an unlabelled decorative graphic standing in for real content.

antiPatterns: Autoplay with no pause control (WCAG 2.2.2) — not built here, and PROPOSED default is autoplay OFF entirely
Modelling slides as role=tab/tabpanel (a slide is not an independent view)
Colour-only dot state (dot uses aria-current + a visible scale/fill change, not hue alone)
Real photography or drawn icons standing in for placeholder imagery — SVG rect placeholders only, per the wave-4 DO-NOT-RULE
A single tab stop that swallows arrow keys the page would otherwise use for scrolling

tokenValidation.result: PASS — bound vars match resolved light+dark; re-verify via _validate_binds_resolve.py per the receipt's claim table (check-D canon-block failure is DECLARED, same class every unregistered wave-4 snippet carries).
tokenValidation.$note: Built wave 4, lane C (Sonnet), #210. No pressables outside the documented controls.

mustNotNeighbour.$note: A second autoplaying region on the same page (competing motion, WCAG 2.2.2)

triggeredBy.$note: a set of 2+ equally-weighted items with no natural list reading order
